Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy

- Bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 2 hours before the slot start time.
- Cancellations made within 2 hours of the slot start time are non-refundable.
- Rescheduling is allowed once per booking, subject to availability, and must also be
  done at least 2 hours before the original slot start time.
- No-shows (not cancelling and not showing up) are treated the same as a late cancellation
  and are non-refundable.
- Refunds for eligible cancellations

  and are non-refundable.
- Refunds for eligible cancellations are processed within 3-5 business days to the
  original payment method.

Equipment Rental

- Badminton rackets: INR 50 per racket per session. Shuttlecocks: INR 20 each.
- Football: INR 100 per session (deposit of INR 500 required, refunded on return).
- Tennis rackets: INR 100 per racket per session. Tennis balls: INR 150 per can of 3.
- Equipment can be reserved in advance when booking a slot, or rented on arrival subject
  to availability.
- All rented equipment must be returned at the facility reception immediately after the
  session. Damaged equipment will be c

t be returned at the facility reception immediately after the
  session. Damaged equipment will be charged at replacement cost.

Membership

- Monthly membership: INR 1500, includes 15% discount on all bookings and priority
  access to peak-hour slots (can book up to 7 days in advance vs. 3 days for non-members).
- Annual membership: INR 15000 (equivalent to 2 months free vs. monthly), same benefits
  as monthly membership.
- Membership can be purchased at the reception or through the booking app.
- Membership is non-transferable and tied to the registered phone number.
- Membership does not include equipment rental disco

- Membership does not include equipment rental discounts.

Opening Hours & Facility Rules

- Badminton Courts 1 & 2: open daily, 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM.
- Football Turf A: open daily, 6:00 AM - 11:00 PM.
- Tennis Court 1: open daily, 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM.
- Multipurpose Room: open daily, 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM (for events, workshops, indoor games).
- The facility is closed on major national holidays; check the notice board or app for
  holiday closures.
- Non-marking shoes are mandatory on all indoor and turf surfaces.
- Outside food is not allowed on the football

shoes are mandatory on all indoor and turf surfaces.
- Outside food is not allowed on the football turf or inside the multipurpose room.
- Each booking slot includes a 10-minute buffer after the hour for changeover; please
  vacate the court/turf promptly at the end of your slot.

Pricing & Payment

- Badminton courts: INR 300 per hour.
- Tennis court: INR 500 per hour.
- Football turf: INR 1200 per hour (minimum booking 60 minutes; most bookings are 90 minutes).
- Multipurpose room: INR 800 per hour (minimum booking 2 hours for events).
- Payment can be made online at the time of booking, or in cash at the facility
  reception before the session starts.
- Peak hours (6 PM - 9 PM on weekdays, and all day on weekends) carry a 10% surcharge
  on the base hourly rate.
